newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse seen maintaining sideways drift.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse seen maintaining sideways drift.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat for the third straight session this week, with some investors fearing the market, currently at 14,753.6 points, would not break resistance at 14,832.7 points.

The latter number represents the main market's September 18, 30-month high. But some analysts noted that despite a general lack of signals only 0.5 percent separated the market from its high and that a breach could signal more growth.
They said the next major signals would be September inflation and company earnings data due at mid-month.
